items.t: FBI probes second cyberattack in months as hackers breach key crime database, sources say
items.d: Hackers breached the FBI's National Crime Information Center, sources say, as the bureau probes the entry point and what data was compromised.

items.t: Trump limits Congress’s accesses to confidential agency, contractor information
items.d: President Trump signed an executive order Friday seeking to block Congress from requesting certain information from federal agencies and their employees, an apparent response to Democrats’ threats of sweeping probes into the administration

items.t: Winchester College teachers to strike for first time in £60,000-a-year school's 644-year history over bosses' investigation into staff member
items.d: Teachers at one of Britain's most prestigious public schools will strike for the first time in its 600 year history because of a disciplinary probe into a colleague.

items.t: Trump says he could reach 'historic' deals with Democrats on immigration, healthcare
items.d: President Trump on Saturday said the new Democratic-controlled Congress presents an opportunity to compromise on immigration and healthcare.

items.t: WATCH: First new D.C. delegate-elect since 1991 hopes Democrats win helps statehood goal
items.d: The last time the District of Columbia had a freshman delegate going through new member orientation on Capitol Hill, the Soviet Union still existed, George H.W. Bush was president and the first Gulf War in Iraq hadn't started yet.
